_doc: 5 Science Facts (Mohd Ashaar), revised take (4K, 75.3s, no World Science Day angle). Audio pieces in order; cuts inside a fact sit under B-roll. Pauses inside a line play 3x faster; each section's speech speed is set from its speaking rate (slower lines sped up more, 1.12-1.30x), solved so the reel lands on 50s.
